name: Hide & Pic – Treasure Hunt
description:
Hide & Pic is a **real-world treasure hunt game for kids** 🪎. One player hides clue cards around the house and snaps a photo 📸 of each spot. The kids find each card, answer a trivia question and unlock the photo of the next spot, all the way to the treasure 🎁.

**Why we built it:** most kids' games keep them glued to a screen. We wanted the opposite: the phone just holds the questions and the photos, and the actual play happens **off the screen** 🏃, running around the house, the backyard, a park or a campsite. Every hunt is pre-built around one topic, mostly educational ones like culture, geography, chemistry, history or math, with a fun fact after most questions, so kids **learn something along the way** 🧠 without it feeling like homework.

**Who it's best for:** parents looking for a birthday party game 🎂, a rainy-day activity or something to do at a cabin in the woods or at camp 🏕️, plus homeschoolers, kids' clubs and party planners. Setup takes about 5 minutes.
author: Cross Subject LLC
